species.title: Orbital shell
species.note: Nested arcs gather around a bright core. The threads burn brightest where their paths overlap.

species.title: Split sphere
species.note: Bright bands cut through a green disc. Each one traces a fold in the same planar orbit.

species.title: Silk current
species.note: A rose-colored filament doubles back through a stack of softer folds.

species.title: Violet braid
species.note: Loops of violet cross and recross. A change in viewpoint pulls the strands apart.

species.title: Phase steps
species.note: Translucent sheets climb through the frame, one displaced from the next.

species.title: Golden weave
species.note: Fine amber threads gather where the planar trajectory changes direction.

species.title: Anchor zero
species.note: The reference specimen at the origin of the search. Its orbit gives the collection a common point of comparison.
